use_case_name: Publish Subsurface Surveillance and Acoustic Contact Reports

evidence_cards.content: The objective is to integrate PPLI data available from J2 messages into the surveillance database to reduce redundancy of surveillance track reporting.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement explicitly defines the high-level goal of the process described in the region for the C2 JU: using PPLI data to reduce redundancy.

evidence_cards.content: The objective is to report Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance information, including bearings, ranges, and tracks derived from ASW sensors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the high-level goal of the use case regarding the exchange of subsurface surveillance data.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs that report subsurface tracks shall have the capability to report a track as a DATUM when contact is lost.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the high-level objective (goal) of the primary actor (C2 JU) regarding the specific functionality described in this section: reporting a track as a DATUM upon loss of contact.

evidence_cards.content: The goal is to report Subsurface surveillance tracks (including positional data, velocity, identity, and time) and to manage reporting responsibilities for these tracks among Joint Units (JUs).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These sections define the specific data elements required for subsurface surveillance reports and the procedures for assigning reporting responsibility, which constitutes the objective of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU has correlated local sensor data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is the explicit state required for the C2 JU to assume R2 of an IU and initiate reporting under the rules described in this section.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have established reporting eligibility for a locally held track (Air, Surface, or Land) and must not have received a remote report on that track to assume R² responsibility.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the prerequisite state of 'local reporting eligibility' and absence of remote reports required before the JU can proceed with publishing responsibilities (assuming R²).

evidence_cards.content: For nonreal-time tracks with TQ field set to value 0, the C2 JU assumes R² responsibility when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific precondition state (locally updated nonreal-time track with TQ=0) under which the JU assumes the reporting role.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have initially achieved Active status, or returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the required system state (Active status) before the C2 JU can perform reporting functions.

evidence_cards.content: Sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration must be performed before transmitting tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies specific processing conditions that must be satisfied prior to transmission.

evidence_cards.content: The exchange of subsurface surveillance information on the interface requires procedures to recognize and resolve detected information differences between local data and data being reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a system state requirement regarding data consistency checks that must be active before or during the reporting process.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a precondition that C² JUs must be configured to transmit via Network PGs according to specific definitions before publishing reports.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs shall not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies that only C² JUs (not NonC² JUs) have the capability/permission to transmit, serving as a role-based precondition for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU shall assume R2 of an IU (including C2 and nonC2 JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data, when specific conditions are met (e.g., J2 PPLI message not received for 40 to 60 seconds).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes that 'correlated local sensor data' is a mandatory precondition for the C2 JU to assume responsibility (R2) and proceed with reporting actions defined in this section.

evidence_cards.content: New local tracks shall not be reported to the interface until an automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on an initial correlation test or on the next test following an initial tentative correlation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory state (correlation failure) that must hold before a new track can be reported/published, serving as a precondition for the reporting use case.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall make an automatic correlation test either: Upon receipt of each remote real-time J3.2 or J3.3 track... which is not confirmed to have an existing correlation to a local track, OR Immediately prior to each transmission of a local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the timing and trigger conditions for the automatic correlation tests required before publishing reports.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have initially achieved Active status, or returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific system state (Active status) required before the C2 JU can begin transmitting tracks, which is a core part of publishing reports.

evidence_cards.content: Before transmitting air, surface, or land tracks, sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration must be performed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These are explicit procedural preconditions that must hold before the transmission of track data can occur.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs that report subsurface tracks shall have the capability to report a track as a DATUM when contact is lost.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a mandatory system capability precondition: the C2 JU must possess the functional ability to convert a live track into a DATUM report upon loss of contact before it can execute the 'Publish Subsurface Surveillance and Acoustic Contact Reports' use case involving DATUMs.

evidence_cards.content: The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a human-in-the-loop precondition: the system must be in a state where an operator has made the explicit decision to declare a DATUM; automated declaration without operator input is not permitted per this requirement.

evidence_cards.content: A JU may assume reporting responsibility (R²) for a Subsurface IU when it determines that the IU is no longer active on the interface and the JU also holds local data on the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific state condition (IU inactive + JU has local data) that must hold before the JU can begin publishing a report using the inactive IU address as the reference TN, acting as a precondition for this specific reporting action.

evidence_cards.content: Each C2 JU has the responsibility to determine whether the data points being detected by its local sensors are currently reported on the interface and if there are any conflicts between locally derived information and information reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a precondition that the C2 JU must have already determined the status of its sensor data relative to the interface before proceeding with reporting actions.

evidence_cards.content: To accomplish this, each C2 JU must continuously correlate locally derived ballistic missile tracks with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an ongoing operational state (continuous correlation) that must be maintained as a condition for proper reporting.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU publishes Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance track information using the J3.4 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific system action and message type that constitutes the execution of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the user action (operator decision) required to initiate the reporting of a DATUM.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs that report subsurface tracks shall have the capability to report a track as a DATUM when contact is lost.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the event (contact is lost) that enables the capability to report a DATUM, serving as the context for the trigger.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for reporting a subsurface track occurs when the C2 JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and the JU also holds local data on the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines the event (determination of inactive status + possession of local data) that initiates the reporting action for this specific variant of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU changes the Environment/Category of a track (e.g., Subsurface to Surface) or when a difference report is rejected by an operator action.

source_locations.location: Paragraph starting 'When a JU changes the Environment/Category...'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This text defines the specific events (track category change or rejection of a difference report) that trigger the reporting process for surveillance data.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance data reporting is initiated by the JU which first detects or initiates a track/point and makes it available for reporting on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the triggering event for surveillance reporting: the initial detection or initiation of a track/point by the JU.

evidence_cards.content: The automatic correlation test is triggered immediately prior to each transmission of a local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific timing event (immediately prior to transmission) that acts as the trigger for the correlation process required before publishing reports.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates that both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This condition acts as a negative trigger or inhibitor for the automatic correlation process, which is the mechanism enabling the publishing of reports. It defines a specific state (both tracks being locally derived) that prevents the use case from proceeding via automation.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This condition acts as a negative trigger or inhibitor for the automatic correlation process. It specifies that if the 'Strength' attribute exceeds a threshold, the automatic reporting/correlation action is blocked.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for publishing subsurface surveillance reports occurs when the C2 JU has tactically significant information derived from ASW sensors (such as bearings, ranges, and tracks) to report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the condition under which the use case initiates: the availability of specific data types (bearings, ranges, tracks) from ASW sensors.

evidence_cards.content: The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly identifies the trigger for reporting a DATUM as an operator-initiated decision, which is a specific variant of the subsurface surveillance reporting use case when contact is lost.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU assumes R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data, when: a. A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or b. A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or c. A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, or d. The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.2.2.2, paragraphs under 'REPORTING OF INACTIVE AND LIMITED STATUS INTERFACE UNITS'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section explicitly defines the triggering events (a-d) that cause the C2 JU to assume responsibility and begin reporting — which directly corresponds to the trigger slot for publishing subsurface surveillance reports when contact status changes or degrades.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for publishing subsurface surveillance and acoustic contact reports is the C2 JU having derived tactically significant information from ASW sensors that requires reporting of bearings, ranges, or tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the event that initiates the use case: when the system has ASW-derived data to report, it triggers the reporting process using J3.0, J3.4, and J5.4 messages.

evidence_cards.content: The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific user action (operator decision) that triggers the reporting of a subsurface track as a DATUM when contact is lost.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and holds local data on the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This determination acts as the trigger event for assuming reporting responsibility ($R^2$) and publishing a J3.4 message for an inactive unit.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for publishing subsurface surveillance and acoustic contact reports occurs when a JU changes the Environment/Category of a track to 'Subsurface (maritime)' from another environment (e.g., Surface, Air, Space, Land, or Unknown), as specified in paragraph 4.7.1.2.1.

source_locations.location: paragraph 4.7.1.2.1, items c and d; also item f for Unknown to Subsurface

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This directly identifies the event that initiates reporting: a change in Environment/Category to Subsurface (maritime) by the JU, which is the core trigger for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall attempt to correlate received PPLI reports with data being received from local sensors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action of correlating incoming reports with local sensor data in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R², the J7.2 Correlation message shall be transmitted with the Response Value (RV) field set to value 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific system response and message transmission required when the C2 JU finds a correlation on a track it owns.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the subsequent actions to stop reporting and drop the track after the correlation message is sent.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU provides the source of track data (Source TN) for Subsurface surveillance track reporting.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the first specific action in the main flow sequence for reporting subsurface tracks.

evidence_cards.content: Established local tracks are reported with all known parameters at the next reporting opportunity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the timing and content requirement for the transmission step in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: All data is time tagged before or during the reporting process.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory data attribute applied during the main flow execution.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU reports subsurface surveillance track data in the J3.4 message, including geodetic latitude and longitude, depth (when available), velocity as course and speed, identity via the Identity field or J3.4I message, discrete identifier codes in the J7.5 message, and time of contact acquisition/loss/datum establishment in the J3.4C1 word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the canonical sequence of reporting actions for publishing subsurface surveillance data — core to main_flow

evidence_cards.content: When contact is lost, the operator may decide to report the track as a DATUM using a J3.4 message with DRT=4, preserving last known position, course, speed, sensor, and timestamp; the DATUM does not move but supports ASW search calculations.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the alternate successful path within main_flow when contact is lost — still part of normal interaction sequence under defined protocol

evidence_cards.content: If contact is regained after being reported as a DATUM, the C2 JU reports a new J3.4 message with DRT set to 0, 1, or 2, reusing the same TN or assigning a new one based on operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Completes the DATUM variant flow by specifying how to resume normal tracking — integral to full main_flow coverage

evidence_cards.content: When the C2 JU ceases reporting a track (except when it becomes an active IU with the same address as the reference TN), the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action in the main flow for terminating subsurface track data via message transmission.

evidence_cards.content: For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, the J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall be transmitted at the time of deactivation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory timing constraint for the main flow action under specific operational conditions.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must continuously correlate locally derived ballistic missile tracks with those reported on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a continuous monitoring action required of the actor during the reporting process to maintain data integrity.

evidence_cards.content: If uncorrelated local ballistic missile tracks are found, the C2 JU shall report them and assume R² for those tracks in accordance with specified rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific reporting action taken when correlation fails, constituting a key step in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: In the event of a conflict between locally derived information and interface-reported information, the C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the resolution mechanism for data conflicts, which is a necessary interaction step before successful publication.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU reports a subsurface surveillance track as a 'track or point' on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action of publishing the report to the network, which is part of the main flow sequence.

evidence_cards.content: For the report, the Identity shall be reported as Friend.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory data field value required during the reporting step.

evidence_cards.content: The Track Number, Platform and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages shall be reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies specific track data elements that must be included in the published report.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact numeric value for identity indicators in the report payload.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line or multisided area for reporting, the TNs used to initiate the segmented line or multisided area shall be transmitted for every report of that line or area, including any change of R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory step in the main flow: retransmitting initiating TNs with each update report, which is part of the canonical success scenario for publishing surveillance reports involving geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: The Point/Line/Area Descriptor field in the initial word shall be set to value 2 (Line) when describing a segmented line and to value 3 (Multi-point Area) when describing a multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines specific message content required during the main flow for correctly encoding the type of geographic feature being reported, directly constraining how the C2 JU constructs its publication message.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data; (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines specific restrictions on the automatic correlation process that occur during the processing of tracks, which is a critical part of the main flow for publishing surveillance reports. It specifies conditions under which the system must inhibit automatic merging of data.

evidence_cards.content: When the remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), it shall be processed for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides a specific rule for how certain incoming messages are processed during the correlation phase of the main flow, detailing the mapping of message types to internal track handling logic.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.XC1 message is transmitted at the next opportunity for new tracks when assuming R² or when data changes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific trigger and timing for publishing surveillance reports (main flow step).

evidence_cards.content: The J3.XC1 message is transmitted periodically at 1/8 the basic message rate for realtime tracks and with each NRT track report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the periodic reporting interval as part of the main flow sequence.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU uses J3.0, J3.4, and J5.4 messages to exchange tactically significant information derived from ASW sensors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific message types used in the main flow for publishing subsurface surveillance reports.

evidence_cards.content: Established local tracks shall be reported with all known parameters at the next reporting opportunity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the timing rule for the main flow action of reporting established tracks.

evidence_cards.content: The J5.4 Acoustic Bearing/Range message is used to exchange information on bearings (ambiguous and resolved) and/or range derived from ASW sensors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific message type for acoustic contact reporting within the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: Bearings shall be reported from the detecting sensor origin.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a constraint on the content of the report during the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting ambiguous passive bearings, the Bearing Report Type (BRT) is set to value 1, and JUs report using both Bearing 1, ASW and Bearing 2, ASW fields.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific data population steps for the main flow when handling ambiguous bearings.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting a resolved bearing, BRT is set to value 2, and JUs report the resolved passive bearing in the Bearing 1, ASW field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific data population steps for the main flow when handling resolved bearings.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting range to an ASW contact without a bearing, JUs set the BRT field to value 3 (Range Only).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a variant step in the main flow for reporting range-only data.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting a bearing and range, JUs set the BRT field to value 0 (Bearing and Range), populate the Bearing 1, ASW field with the bearing, and the Range field with the range.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the standard step in the main flow for reporting combined bearing and range data.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU reports a subsurface surveillance track datum in a J3.4 message with the same Reference TN as the track for which contact has been lost, setting Data Report Type (DRT) = 4 (DATUM), ASW Time Function = 3 (Time Contact Lost) or 1 (Time Datum Established), Hour and Minute as the truncated time contact was lost or DATUM established, and Latitude, Longitude, 15 Meters Depth, and Depth Contact as the last known position.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides the specific message content and sequence required to publish a DATUM report when contact is lost, directly fulfilling the 'main_flow' slot requirement for the alternative success scenario of reporting a track as a DATUM.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate an emergency or force tell alert on a subsurface contact by setting the EMG IND or FT IND in the J5.4 Acoustic Bearing/Range message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific action and message type (J5.4) used to publish acoustic bearing/range data for subsurface contacts in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert initiated via the J3.5 or J5.4 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms the successful completion step where the published report is accepted by the system/receivers.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action (transmission) and message type (Network PGs) for the C2 JU actor within the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance data is included in the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific message format used to publish subsurface surveillance data, a core component of the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture if a correlation is not found.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This step describes the action taken by the C2 JU when no existing track matches the incoming data, which is a necessary part of the main flow for publishing new surveillance information derived from sensors.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the C2 JU shall transmit a J7.2 Correlation message with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific interaction sequence and message content required when the system detects a duplicate track (correlation) during the reporting process.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the terminal condition for retaining reporting responsibility during normal operation, which is part of the main flow's success boundary — the report remains published until explicitly relinquished or dropped.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU uses J3.0, J3.4, and J5.4 messages to exchange tactically significant information derived from ASW sensors, specifically reporting bearings, ranges, and tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific message types used for subsurface surveillance reporting in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: For Subsurface surveillance track reporting, the source of track data shall be provided (Source TN), established local tracks shall be reported with all known parameters at the next reporting opportunity, and all data shall be time tagged.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory steps and data requirements for publishing a track report in the normal interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: The J5.4 Acoustic Bearing/Range message is used to exchange information on bearings (ambiguous and resolved) and/or range derived from ASW sensors, with bearings reported from the detecting sensor origin.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the distinct action and message format for reporting acoustic contact data within the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the human-in-the-loop requirement for initiating the alternative reporting flow (DATUM) when contact is lost, which is part of the canonical success scenario for this use case variant.

evidence_cards.content: The DATUM shall be reported in a J3.4 message with the same Reference TN as the track for which contact has been lost, and the other J3.4 fields set as follows: Data Report Type (DRT) = 4 (DATUM), ASW Time Function = 3 (Time Contact Lost) or 1 (Time Datum Established), Hour and Minute truncated time that contact was lost or DATUM established, and Latitude, Longitude, 15 Meters Depth, and Depth Contact set to last known position.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact message structure and field values required to successfully publish a subsurface surveillance track as a DATUM upon loss of contact — completing the main flow for this variant of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number. No other JU shall report the contact using that track number, unless one of the following occurs: (1) A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received containing the TN; or (2) A J3.4 message containing the TN is not received for two consecutive periodic updates.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary interaction sequence and conditions under which normal track reporting proceeds — specifically, when no drop message is received and periodic updates are maintained, the original reporter retains responsibility and continues publishing without interruption.

evidence_cards.content: Any other JU may report what it believes to be the same contact using a different TN. When this is done, only locally derived data shall be reported in the J3.4 message, i.e., the J3.4 messages shall not contain data derived only by the reception of remote data from other IU(s) reporting the same contact.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative but still-successful variant of the main flow where multiple JUs report the same subsurface contact independently using different track numbers, constrained to local-only data derivation — this constitutes a valid parallel success path within the use case scope.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message to drop a track.

source_locations.location: list item a under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is an alternative successful path for subsurface surveillance reporting — instead of publishing bearing/range or track data, the C2 JU may choose to drop the track entirely when it is no longer relevant or valid, which diverges from the main flow of publishing active track reports.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 1) Difference Report message to report changes in track parameters without retransmitting full track data.

source_locations.location: list item b under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This represents an alternative successful reporting path where only delta updates are sent rather than full track reports, optimizing bandwidth and reducing redundancy while still maintaining situational awareness — diverging from Step 3 of main flow which requires full parameter reporting.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 2) Change Data Order message to modify the sequence or priority of track data transmission.

source_locations.location: list item c under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This allows the C2 JU to alter how track data is ordered in transmission — an alternative operational path that affects presentation or processing order without changing content, diverging from standard sequential reporting in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 3) Emergency Status Change message to indicate urgent change in track status.

source_locations.location: list item d under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides an alternative successful path for handling high-priority tracks by signaling emergency status, which may trigger different downstream handling — diverging from routine track reporting in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 4) Force Tell Status Change message to compel another unit to report on a specific track.

source_locations.location: list item e under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This enables delegation or redistribution of reporting responsibility — an alternative coordination path that alters who publishes the next report, diverging from the default assumption that the originating C2 JU continues reporting.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 5) Strength Change message to update the confidence level or reliability metric associated with a track.

source_locations.location: list item f under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This allows dynamic adjustment of track credibility without altering positional or identity data — an alternative metadata-update path that supports decision-making without requiring full re-reporting, diverging from main flow’s focus on physical track attributes.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to mark a track as part of a training exercise.

source_locations.location: list item g under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides an alternative classification path for non-operational tracks, allowing them to be flagged separately from real-world threats — diverging from standard operational reporting in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JU uses J7.1 Data Update Request (ACT = 0) Data Update Request by Request Indicator message to solicit updated track data based on a request identifier.

source_locations.location: list item h under 'Information Management data'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This initiates a pull-based alternative to push-based reporting — instead of proactively sending data, the C2 JU requests updates from others, diverging from the main flow’s assumption of autonomous publication.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: When a track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not transmitted even if the JU ceases reporting it.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies another alternative path where track continuity is maintained via another active participant, avoiding explicit drop signaling.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting ambiguous passive bearings, C2 JU sets Bearing Report Type (BRT) to value 1 and reports using both the Bearing 1, ASW and Bearing 2, ASW fields of the J5.4E0 and J5.4C1 words, with origins of both bearings being the same.

source_locations.location: Page 4-202, paragraph starting 'When reporting ambiguous passive bearings'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an alternative flow for handling ambiguous bearing data that diverges from the main flow's standard resolved bearing reporting procedure.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting a resolved bearing, C2 JU sets BRT to value 2 and reports the resolved passive bearing in the Bearing 1, ASW field; upon receipt of BRT=2, JUs shall not process the Bearing 2, ASW field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the alternative handling path for resolved bearings, which differs from the ambiguous bearing case and represents a successful variant of acoustic reporting.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting range to an ASW contact without a bearing, C2 JU sets BRT to value 3 (Range Only); when reporting both bearing and range, BRT is set to value 0, with Bearing 1, ASW and Range fields populated accordingly.

source_locations.location: Page 4-202, paragraph starting 'When reporting range to an ASW contact'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These are two distinct alternative flows for partial or combined acoustic data reporting, diverging from the full bearing-and-range scenario in the main flow.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the alternative flow divergence point from normal reporting when contact is maintained; specifies that DATUM reporting requires manual operator intervention rather than automatic system action.

evidence_cards.content: The DATUM shall be reported in a J3.4 message with the same Reference TN as the track for which contact has been lost, with Data Report Type (DRT) set to 4 (DATUM).

source_locations.location: Page 58 (first image), section 4.4.5.2.5 items b and (1)

evidence_cards.content: If contact is regained after a DATUM is established, a J3.4 message with DRT set to value 0, 1 or 2 shall be reported with the same TN as the DATUM, or a new TN depending on operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the recovery path from the DATUM alternative flow back to normal track reporting when contact is re-established.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU ceases reporting a track (except when that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN), it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific alternative path for terminating subsurface tracks via explicit drop report transmission, diverging from normal continuous reporting.

evidence_cards.content: For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall be transmitted at time of deactivation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies mandatory alternative flow behavior for specific operational contexts (NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, FWDAs) requiring explicit termination messages upon deactivation.

evidence_cards.content: If a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on a remote track, it will automatically purge those tracks (DRT = 0-3) after a specific system-selected time interval.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an automated recovery mechanism in the absence of explicit termination signals, representing an alternative flow for handling lost or stale remote tracks.

evidence_cards.content: An EW fix resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an alternative successful path for reporting where a fix is derived from prior LOB reports but requires a new track number (TN), diverging from the main flow which typically retains or assigns TNs based on direct sensor correlation.

evidence_cards.content: When an AOP is changed to a fix, the TN of the previously reported AOP shall be used for the new fix.

source_locations.location: last sentence of paragraph under section 4.4.7.1.2 ELECTRONIC WARFARE FIX REPORTING

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines another variant in the alternative flow: when transitioning from an Area of Probability (AOP) to a fix, the system reuses the existing TN instead of generating a new one — a divergence from the standard rule for EW fixes from LOBs.

evidence_cards.content: An alternative flow exists where an Emergency (EMG) or Force Tell (FT) alert is active; in this state, the C2 JU sets the EMG IND or FT IND to 1 in the J3.4 (Subsurface Track) or J5.4 (Acoustic Bearing/Range) messages, triggered by a J7.0 message (ACT=3 for EMG, ACT=4 for FT).

source_locations.location: Table 4.7-3 (rows for SUBSURFACE TRACK and ACOUSTIC BEARING/RANGE, columns for EMG/FT IND SET TO 1) and Notes 1 and 2

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific data modifications and triggering conditions for the legal alternative path where alerts are published alongside track data.

evidence_cards.content: A constraint on the alternative flow specifies that Emergency alerts (EMG IND set to 1) shall not be initiated for Reference Points or Space/Ballistic Missile Tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific exclusion where the alternative flow for emergency reporting is prohibited for certain track types.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU finds a correlation with a track for which it has R2 responsibility, it must transmit a J7.2 Correlation message with Response Value (RV) set to 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), cease reporting the track, and transmit a J7.0 Drop Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception flow for handling reverse correlation conflicts when the local unit retains responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU receives a J2 PPLI message but no subsequent messages are received and it has no local data, it assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception behavior when a correlation cannot be established and data flow stops.

evidence_cards.content: If position or other data in a PPLI meets a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated, and the C2 JU shall initiate a new surveillance track report using a new track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the recovery/exception path for data decorrelation events requiring track re-initialization.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU assumes R2 of an Interface Unit (IU) if a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or if a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) is received with NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence.

source_locations.location: Page 8, section 4.4.2.2.2 paragraphs a and b

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the trigger conditions for assuming reporting responsibility due to inactive status exceptions.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the receiving JU transmits a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message identifying the Source TN as Retained and the surveillance TN as Dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Handles the exception case of track number mismatch during correlation with a remote responsible unit.

evidence_cards.content: If an operator action has been taken which selectively released a new local track for reporting, it shall be transmitted, regardless of the results of correlation testing.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception to the standard automatic correlation failure requirement (precondition), allowing manual override to force transmission even if correlation tests would normally prevent it.

evidence_cards.content: Under the condition of irregular reporting of nonreal-time tracks, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an explicit exception flow: when tracks are reported irregularly (nonreal-time), the system must suppress transmission of the J7.0 deactivation message, altering normal track termination behavior.

evidence_cards.content: System design should allow for an override in cases where operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all before transmitting tracks after achieving Active status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception path to the minimum wait precondition — allowing bypass of standard timing constraints under operational necessity, which constitutes an exception flow for urgent reporting scenarios.

evidence_cards.content: If contact is regained after a DATUM has been reported, the C2 JU shall report a J3.4 message with DRT set to value 0, 1, or 2 using the same TN as the DATUM, or assign a new TN depending on operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the recovery path from an exception state (lost contact/DATUM) back to normal tracking, which constitutes the exception flow for regaining contact.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and holds local data on it, it assumes R² by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific exception flow where an inactive Interface Unit triggers a track report assumption to maintain surveillance continuity.

evidence_cards.content: Should the inactive IU return to the interface as an Active IU, the JU holding R² shall cease reporting the IU, but a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the recovery behavior for when the exceptional condition (inactive IU) resolves, specifying that normal termination messages are suppressed.

evidence_cards.content: If a TN has been previously reported on the IU using other than the IU's address, the J7.2 message may be used to resolve the dual designation to the IU's address.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides the resolution mechanism for handling conflicting track designations arising from the inactive IU scenario.

evidence_cards.content: There may be cases when a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on the remote track; each system will have the capability to automatically purge those tracks (DRT = 0-3) after a specific time interval.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Handles the exception of missing termination signals by defining an automatic purge mechanism based on a timeout interval.

evidence_cards.content: Under the condition of automatic purging due to lack of updates, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a constraint on message transmission during the exception handling process of automatic purging.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates that both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (i.e., being updated with local positional data).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an exception condition where the system must inhibit automatic correlation, preventing the normal reporting flow for conflicting local tracks.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if they have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict, unless an initialization parameter or operator selectable capability is used to inhibit this restriction.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an exception path triggered by identity conflicts, requiring either manual intervention or specific configuration to proceed, otherwise blocking automatic correlation.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if they have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current, unless an initialization parameter or operator selectable capability is used to inhibit this restriction.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an exception path triggered by Mode II code discrepancies, blocking automatic correlation unless explicitly overridden.

evidence_cards.content: Systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement, even if the other track has a Strength field value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This clarifies a boundary condition for the exception flow regarding track strength, ensuring that 'No Statement' does not trigger a correlation block.

evidence_cards.content: Changes from a Valid Data value to a No Data status as a result of the clearing function (J7.5 (ACT = 0)) will not cause the transmission of a change report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition where a state change occurs but reporting is suppressed, preventing unnecessary transmissions.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks with Valid Data which subsequently fail to respond to interrogations shall not be changed to the No Data status unless a Clear action is taken.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a protection rule against automatic degradation of track status due to non-response, requiring explicit operator/system action to clear data.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific time-based exception condition (wait period) that prevents the normal transmission of tracks immediately after status changes.

evidence_cards.content: Under the condition where automatic purging of nonreal-time tracks occurs after a specific time interval, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Explicitly defines an exception flow where the standard track termination message is suppressed due to system-purged tracks.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and the JU also holds local data on the IU, it shall assume R² by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN.

evidence_cards.content: If a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, the C² JU shall assume R² of an IU and report it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence_cards.content: If a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, the C² JU shall assume R² of the IU and report it.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, the C² JU shall assume R² of the IU and report it.

evidence_cards.content: If the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0, the C² JU shall assume R² of the IU and report it.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a data quality threshold that triggers the exception flow for assuming responsibility and reporting the unit.

evidence_cards.content: When assuming R² of an IU under these conditions, the C² JU reports the Identity as Friend, maintains previous Track Number/Platform values, and sets the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific data formatting and field value constraints required during the execution of this exception flow.

evidence_cards.content: After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, C2 JUs capable of assuming R2 shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory waiting period and verification step (exception to normal transmission) triggered by status changes (Inactive/TDS Failure) before the main reporting flow can resume.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds following a return to Active status.
